lines.l: Only you, when I really get nothing to do
Can it be true, only you
When I'm looking for somebody new
Only change my mind when I feel so right
Then you make me see love is free
Only you, when I look at your eyes in the blue
When it feels just a leap by the moon
Only you, when I really get nothing to do, can be true
Only you, when I'm looking for somebody new, you're the proof
Only change my mind, when I feel so blind, and you make me see, love is free
Only you, when I look at your eyes in the blue
Only you, when you tear down the lead by the moon
You change my mind, when I feel so blind
Then you make me see, love is free
My love's alive, you hold me so tight
